title: BPBO: Blindness-Preserving Brickwork Optimization by Certified Region Resynthesis
summary: Universal blind quantum computation (UBQC) hides a client's computation by using a computation-independent BFK09 brickwork graph and encoding the computation in measurement angles, which limits the use of graph-changing optimizations. We study blindness-preserving brickwork optimization (BPBO): certified local resynthesis of BFK09-compatible brickwork patterns below the blinding layer.
